title: /assistant page loads for a seeded org with a project selected, no console errors
preconditions: Logged in as a seeded test org user with a project selected
expectedResult: Page renders the chat panel, sidebar (Quick Actions/History tabs), and a welcome message greeting the user by first name. No unhandled console errors, no infinite loading state.

title: Sending a simple message returns a rendered response within a reasonable time
expectedResult: A streamed or complete response appears in the chat within ~15 seconds; the 'thinking' animation is shown while waiting and disappears once content arrives.

title: /health/ready returns 200 even when the Python AI Engine dependency is down
description: healthRoutes' /ready check treats aiEngine as non-critical: readiness is gated only on MongoDB being healthy or not_configured. Confirms the gateway does not report itself unhealthy just because the LLM backend is temporarily unreachable.
preconditions: Python AI Engine (AI_Assistant_Python) is stopped or unreachable
expectedResult: Response is 200 with status:'ready' and dependencies.aiEngine:'unavailable', not a 503 — the AI Engine outage does not take down the gateway's own health signal.

title: A Quick Action button sends its preset query and produces a response
steps: Click any Quick Actions card in the sidebar (e.g. 'Evidence Discovery')
expectedResult: The preset query text appears as a user message in the transcript, and an AI response begins streaming without further input.

title: New Chat clears the transcript and starts a fresh conversation
preconditions: An active conversation with at least one exchanged message
expectedResult: The transcript resets to a single welcome message, conversationId is cleared, and sessionStorage's stored session is removed.
